worldcombat.skill.refresh.summary: Stands still and breathes out to clear poison, bad poison, burn and paralysis from itself at once, leaving a brief clear window that repels those same three statuses. It does not heal, and does not touch sleep or freeze.
worldcombat.skill.refresh.use.0: Clear a burn or poison before it drains you
worldcombat.skill.refresh.use.1: Break out of paralysis and act normally again
worldcombat.skill.refresh.use.2: Pre-cleanse and use the clear window to block the next status
worldcombat.skill.refresh.description.1: The cleanse rings %1$s blocks around the body; it takes %2$s of standing still to shed the afflictions.
worldcombat.skill.refresh.stance.deep: Deep breath: x1.3 wind-up and x1.25 cooldown for a x1.5 clear window (a longer protection).
worldcombat.skill.refresh.stance.quick: Quick cleanse: x0.85 wind-up and x0.8 cooldown, but the clear window is only x0.65 (a brief purge).
worldcombat.skill.refresh.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.refresh.preference.dee: On: longer wind-up and cooldown, clear window x1.5. Off (quick cleanse): faster and more frequent, window only x0.65. Each direction has its moments.
When poison or burn has worn the companion below this ratio, it treats Refresh as an emergency self-rescue; lower endures longer, higher cleanses at the first wound.
